stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class). No Common Data Set could be found on marian.edu. IPEDS reports no SAT/ACT figures and the 2026-27 catalog says the university is test blind, so no score ranges are recorded. International applicant/admit counts and GPA are not available.

cost.notes: Marian's tuition page for 2026/2027: full-time (12-19 hours) $21,700 per semester ($43,400 per year), room and board $15,040, book estimate $1,200 per year. The page's total on-campus cost is $58,440 (tuition plus room and board); the page does not state other expenses, so no total cost of attendance is recorded. Fall 2027 rates are not yet published.
